notes.title: Patch 1.2
notes.notes:
Patch 1.2:
- dozen new insurgents
- damage indicators
- ambient sound
- all tilesets were replaced
- player now reacts to nearby blocks
- voice is now louder
- improved effects of breaking tiles
- new mesh emitter at background
- maps have more decorative elements

notes.title: Version 1.1 Update
notes.notes:
Version 1.1 Update brings forth:
[list]
[*]Defeated foes does not need to be crushed again, stages are much easier to finish now
[*]Better player controls
[*]Rattling noise removed
[*]Resolution scaling for improved performance
[/list]
